main_conclusion.reason_KO: 사용자의 의도한 native 모서리 가시성 개입에는 러너만의 정확한 재료 마스크가 필수는 아니다. 선택 팔레트의 올바른 러너 종단과 그에 인접한 모든 시각적으로 가능한 끝점 재료를 포함하는 보수적 국소 포위 영역을 불투명하게 가리면, 러너와 블록의 내부 접합선을 별도로 분리하지 않아도 해당 끝점 후보의 외관을 가릴 수 있다. 다만 이는 물리 native점 좌표의 증명이 아니라 구조에 근거한 약개입이다.
main_conclusion.original_pilot_remains_valid: The original pilot explicitly asked for a separately bounded visible MATERIAL-END region. Its five UNKNOWNs faithfully express failure of that stricter measurement; this method critique neither overturns them nor changes any blind observation.
main_conclusion.RGB_support: All five saved views support qualitative localization of a selected-pallet lower-end/block-runner junction, sufficient to motivate a separate conservative-enclosure proposal. This review does not supply or certify any numerical box, all-candidate hard bound, pixel mask or physical corner location.
main_conclusion.no_immediate_conversion: Do not turn 5 UNKNOWN cases or the reported V164 15 UNKNOWN attempts into passed cases. A new prospective enclosure definition and its per-attempt construction/coverage checks are required in a separate sidecar/protocol.

semantically_valid_conditions: Identify the selected instance and the specific camera-native lower end through RGB topology: incident long lower edge, end/support termination, and attachment to that selected pallet. Wood color or q presence alone is insufficient.

Define an uncertainty envelope around the union of every endpoint/material alternative that remains visually plausible under the stated structural interpretation. The envelope may include attached block edge and some background as margins; it must not simply choose the easiest visible wood patch.

Freeze the enclosure rule and weak proposal before inspecting intervention results or model scores. Do not center it on q by default or use uncertain nominal reference/wireframe as an exact bound. Retain failures without shifting/retrying to obtain a pass.

Cover the entire proposed envelope with fully opaque donor support in the changed full RGB, including conservative interpolation/contributing-pixel support; covering only its center or one material sample is insufficient.

Keep q/L/native/selected instance and all saved sampling operators unchanged. If envelope coverage or its visibility in the unchanged input cannot be shown, the case remains UNKNOWN for the intervention claim.
For an adjacent sham, verify that it is outside every intended-end candidate envelope and supplies the frozen matched support/mass conditions. A sham on another plausible end is not a sham.

Call the outcome a structurally supported conservative endpoint-appearance intervention. Broader masking changes surrounding block/edge cues too; it does not identify a pure single-pixel causal effect or create a native D/E/quality label.
semantically_invalid_conditions: Replacing the runner-end hypothesis with arbitrary pallet material, top deck presence, the lower stacked pallet, whole-pallet coverage, or an EPAL block face that does not enclose all plausible intended endpoints.
Using a nominal projection circle, a fixed 3px radius or a diagnostic crop border as a hard physical endpoint bound without independent RGB support.
Choosing one ambiguous candidate and leaving another uncovered, clipping an unresolved candidate outside the image/diagnostic window, or treating padding as evidence.
Claiming exact physical native occlusion or intervention purity merely because a broad patch overlaps some wood; opaque overlap must be tied to the complete stated structural candidate envelope.
Relaxing the coverage/identity rule after seeing a failed donor placement, reporting only successful scales, or admitting new training targets from this method note.

case_specific_RGB_method_notes.method_note: Full-frame RGB identifies the selected upper pallet front-right support/end neighborhood. The EPAL block lower edge and thin adjoining lower rim are visible against the floor. A small junction enclosure can include the thin rim without tracing its block/runner interface; a rectangle extended down/left can also cover the other pallet, so support cannot be inferred from the nominal cyan dot or a generic block box.

The selected upper pallet right block, its bottom rim and adjoining long lower edge are visible. The runner-only interface is blurred, but a joint neighborhood can conservatively include both sides of that interface. The lower pallet immediately below/left is a competing structure; any actual enclosure must demonstrate that it follows this upper pallet rather than covering whichever wood is nearby.

Full-frame RGB shows the selected upper front-left EPAL block and the narrow lower wooden edge continuing along its base. An enclosing corner/junction neighborhood need not resolve the exact seam. Diagnostic left black padding is invalid and provides no bound; clipping or an enclosure limited by that diagnostic window would require an UNKNOWN result. The unchanged full-frame view, not the nominal marker, supplies the structural context.

The selected upper rear-right end block and thin lower strip continuing diagonally away from it are visible; a background gap separates part of that junction from the lower pallet. This supports a qualitative upper-junction enclosure proposal. A box that instead captures the top deck at q or the lower pallet would change the endpoint task. The existing material-only UNKNOWN is not contradicted.

A second view shows the same selected upper rear-right block/lower-strip junction and nearby lower pallet. The upper end is structurally localized even though the thin runner seam is not independently segmented. An enclosure must include the complete visually plausible upper-end alternatives and keep the lower pallet/top deck from serving as substitutes. No precise endpoint or numeric enclosure is certified here.

distinctions.material_selective_intervention: If the scientific claim requires changing only runner material while leaving the support block untouched, separate component segmentation or an equivalent material-selective proof is necessary; the five pilot UNKNOWNs remain a real limitation.
distinctions.conservative_endpoint_intervention: If the claim is removal of all visually plausible intended native-endpoint appearance, broader correct-junction coverage is sufficient in principle; its extra context removal must be disclosed and sham-controlled.
distinctions.physical_point_gold: No single saved RGB view or nominal reference here establishes all physical endpoint possibilities with a hard numeric bound. Any enclosure remains assistant weak structural support, not gold.
distinctions.training_semantics: Owner/presence, expected-part visibility, native external visibility, and coordinate quality remain separate. An enclosure proposal does not convert one into the other.

recommended_next_step: Separately freeze a conservative native-endpoint uncertainty-envelope pilot on the same five cases, with explicit structural limits and complete-coverage/sham checks before outcomes. Preserve the original material-region pilot and all 66 V164 attempts unchanged; do not count this method review as a new observation or automatic admission.
V164_attempt_status: Root-reported 66 attempts including 15 UNKNOWN/no-images; not independently read or changed in this review.
